title: The Role of Quantum in Hybrid Quantum-Classical Neural Networks: An Empirical Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2601.04732v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Quantum machine learning has emerged as a promising application domain for near-term quantum hardware, particularly through hybrid quantum-classical models that leverage both classical and quantum processing. Although numerous hybrid architectures have been proposed and demonstrated successfully on benchmark tasks, a significant open question remains regarding the specific contribution of quantum components to the overall performance of these models. In this work, we aim to shed light on the impact of quantum processing within hybrid quantum-classical neural network architectures through a rigorous statistical study under ideal, noise-free simulation. We systematically assess a selection of commonly used HQNN architectures on three binary medical classification tasks covering medical signal data as well as planar and volumetric images. translated_title: 混合量子-经典神经网络中量子的作用：一项实证评估
translated_abstract: 量子机器学习已成为近期量子硬件的一个有前景的应用领域，特别是通过同时利用经典与量子处理的混合量子-经典模型。尽管已有众多混合架构被提出并在基准任务上成功演示，但关于量子组件对这些模型整体性能的具体贡献，仍是一个重要的未解问题。在本工作中，我们旨在通过在理想的、无噪声模拟环境下开展严谨的统计研究，阐明量子处理在混合量子-经典神经网络（HQNN）架构中的影响。我们在涵盖医学信号数据以及平面和体积图像的三个二分类医学任务上，系统地评估了一系列常用的HQNN架构。在此过程中，我们检验了可归因于经典与量子方面（例如……）的影响。
tldr: 本文通过理想无噪声模拟下的严谨统计研究，在三个医学二分类任务上系统评估了常用混合量子-经典神经网络架构，以揭示量子组件对模型整体性能的实际贡献。
